assessments.reasoning: The ngrep project's commit-pinned LICENSE is primary evidence for the captured project reference. Its 3,393-byte body hashes to the claim's publisher revision. Bytes [0,1840) cover Ritter's 2017 attribution through the disclaimer and its terminating LF. The 1,553-byte suffix begins with three additional LFs, followed by the tcpkill attribution at byte 1843 and Dug Song's copyright at byte 1933. This rules out whole-file identity. [ngrep LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpr5/ngrep/351ac491358f89a7860bbbe9963cb4bc7d60000f/LICENSE)

The 8,703-byte SPDX detail record identifies `licenseId` as `ngrep` and marks `isDeprecatedLicenseId` false in the pinned data revision. Parsing the JSON decoded the two escaped apostrophes, and the resulting `licenseText` matched the publisher prefix at all 1,840 byte positions. The template and HTML use different formatting. The `crossRef` reports `match` as the string `false` for a moving `master` URL. That separate field does not contradict the comparison of `licenseText` against a bounded passage at the pinned publisher commit. [SPDX detail record](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/json/details/ngrep.json)

The entire pinned SPDX standalone file is 1,840 bytes and matched the publisher prefix at every byte position. Its terminal LF matches the prefix, while the additional separator LFs and tcpkill material fall outside the file. This text and the detail record share the same SPDX data revision. [SPDX standalone text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/text/ngrep.txt)

The SPDX repository's annotated tag object `76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b` names `v3.29.0` and identifies SPDX License List version 3.29.0 in its message. Its target is explicitly a commit, `31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48`. Both raw data URLs use the same `spdx/license-list-data` repository and that exact target commit. The API reports the tag unsigned. [Annotated SPDX tag object](https://api.github.com/repos/spdx/license-list-data/git/tags/76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b)

limitations: The subsequent Dug Song notice is outside the compared passage.

The publisher capture establishes the LICENSE representation at the cited commit. The inspected sources leave the mapping to a named ngrep release unresolved. Version 3.29.0 identifies the SPDX License List.
Legal equivalence, rights for other works, reuse, and installation require separate evidence.

The displayed adoption digest was checked as a declared pin. The policy bundle itself was outside the supplied captures. This assessment records the source findings and does not establish publication qualification.
reasoning: Independent UTF-8 byte comparisons after JSON decoding found zero differences between the publisher's [0,1840) prefix and each pinned SPDX representation, without normalization. All three hash to SHA-256 `a995449178fc587d652efb9a300d2db482a376c800ca3ce7346d8eeb613ba4dc`. All nine full-body lengths and SHA-256 digests matched their capture envelopes. The annotated SPDX tag binds both data URLs to the asserted release target. The whole-file, representation, and version challenges support the claim at its stated scope.
